verdicts.reason: A drops the hero image, 'The Quiet Hours' book, entirely. Its Inkwell & Lantern logo is shrunk to an illegible speck in the card's top-left corner, the fine print is too small to read, and the card is just a centred slab with no imagery. B keeps the book, the readable logo and a sensible left-to-right flow, but its card runs into the top and right canvas edges with almost no margin. B's stack is also cramped, and its fine print is nearly the same size as the body copy, which weakens the hierarchy.
